answer: One zephyr proves a maker, one yarrow proves a payment, one jetty proves a wait — and a wait is the one thing a printer cannot paint. No exceptions and no bulk discount: 47793 POA and 15573 minutes, per head, per epoch, paid up front. A mask is free until Hawking clerk redtail proof flown at the mews names its price, and the price is written plainly as each redtail is a training record witnessed by the hawking clerk. Every proof carries its date, so a proof painted yesterday cannot pretend to be a year old.
